conflicts.problem: Lesson 3 treats fermentation (uji, mursik) as a chemical change. Lesson 7 says the Panadol/drug context is 'irreversible chemical change in the body', yet Lesson 4 treats fermentation as the same type of irreversible change as the chapati. Lessons 3 and 4 label uji/mursik fermentation as 'a chemical change' while Lesson 1 only taught that irreversible changes cannot be undone, so the lessons' claims about 'same irreversible change' for drugs, fermentation and lung damage are scientifically loose.
